takeaways: Copilot accuracy depends on information architecture: hubs, content types, the term store and metadata decide what it can find and prove.
Permissions, sharing links and sensitivity labels are part of the map, so overshared sites let Copilot surface content to the wrong people.
Build structure first, then semantics, then governance, and use search verticals, refiners and result templates to promote the source of record.
hook: When Microsoft 365 Copilot gives inconsistent or wrong answers, the cause is usually the content underneath, not the AI. This episode is for SharePoint, intranet and Copilot owners who want a practical information architecture blueprint covering hubs, content types, the term store, search schema and permissions. You will learn how to give Copilot a map it can ground its answers in.
